name: Aura Flow
description: Stability AI - Photographic realism with flowing stylistic accents Ported verbatim from EricRollei/Local_LLM_Prompt_Enhancer.
length_guidance: Aim for ~180 words blending photoreal cues with stylistic direction.
detail_expectation: Combine technical photography language with vivid stylistic descriptors and ambiance cues.
avoid: Overly abstract artistic terminology without photographic grounding
negative_prompt_default: blurry, low quality, distorted, deformed, watermark, signature
few_shot_intro: Example transformations of a user idea into a Aura Flow-formatted prompt:
user_message_schema_hint: The user message arrives as JSON with fields: { raw_idea, target_model, source_image_count, aspect_ratio, camera_details?, references? }. Weave camera_details naturally into the prompt — do NOT echo them as a settings list at the end.

provenance.notes: Ported verbatim. EricRollei's original field names and ordering preserved; platform_block lifted from text_to_image_node.py when present, otherwise empty (the master template + preferences/avoid/quality_tokens alone are enough for platforms without a bespoke block).
